Container.Name: Gerbil
Container.Overview:
Gerbil (https://github.com/fosrl/gerbil) is the WireGuard interface management server and relay for Pangolin. It is required to run alongside Pangolin to enable tunneling. (https://github.com/fosrl/pangolin).
Chat with us on Discord!
https://pangolin.net/discord
